facts.fact: Devan first smelled nightbark resin at twenty, from a sealed jar passed around a classroom during his border training on the witness rule.
facts.why: needed because he must recognise the resin smell and know the rule's details in chapter 2 without a named instructor or school.

facts.fact: Janu says it is the first time in eleven years Devan has asked for food himself.
facts.why: needed because it shows his habit of not eating, set up at the chapter 1 feast, and makes Janu's reaction believable.
